token.label: API Key
token.description: Go My Profile page to find your API Key at the bottom.

templateID.label: Select a Thankster Template
templateID.description: If you are passing text or images from prior steps in this step into the Thankster template chosen above, be sure to select a template that has corresponding text or images boxes to pass it into. Either way, the font and style of your cards will be taken from the template you select.

country.label: Sender Country
country.description: If not US, type the two character country code.

r_country.label: Receiver Country
r_country.description: If not US, type the two character country code.

api_text_one.label: Text One
api_text_one.description: Optional - if left blank, it will take the message from your Thankster template. Otherwise, map this to an api text box in the Thankster template being in Thankster Template field, 200 character maximum suggested.

api_text_two.label: Text Two
api_text_two.description: Optional - if left blank, it will take the message from your Thankster template. Otherwise, map this to an api text box in the Thankster template being in Thankster Template field, 200 character maximum suggested.

api_text_three.label: Text Three
api_text_three.description: Optional - if left blank, it will take the message from your Thankster template. Otherwise, map this to an api text box in the Thankster template being in Thankster Template field, 200 character maximum suggested.

api_text_four.label: Text Four
api_text_four.description: Optional - if left blank, it will take the message from your Thankster template. Otherwise, map this to an api text box in the Thankster template being in Thankster Template field, 200 character maximum suggested.

api_image_one.label: Image One (URL)
api_image_one.description: Optional image URL for image one. Be sure this image is at least 1500 x 1900 pixels and has that aspect ratio to avoid stretching or pixelated.

api_image_two.label: Image Two (URL)
api_image_two.description: Optional image URL for image one. Be sure this image is at least 1500 x 1900 pixels and has that aspect ratio to avoid stretching or pixelated.

api_image_three.label: Image Three (URL)
api_image_three.description: Optional image URL for image one. Be sure this image is at least 1500 x 1900 pixels and has that aspect ratio to avoid stretching or pixelated.

api_image_four.label: Image Four (URL)
api_image_four.description: Optional image URL for image one. Be sure this image is at least 1500 x 1900 pixels and has that aspect ratio to avoid stretching or pixelated.

sender_image.label: Sender Image
sender_image.description: Optional image URL for return address (on the envelope). The recommended image size is 300x120 pixels or that aspect ratio to avoid stretching or pixelation. The image will be on top of the text and it will be downsized preserving the aspect ratio to fit the boundaries if necessary.

recipient_image.label: Recipient Image
recipient_image.description: Optional image URL for return address (on the envelope). The recommended image size is 300x120 pixels or that aspect ratio to avoid stretching or pixelation. The image will be on top of the text and it will be downsized preserving the aspect ratio to fit the boundaries if necessary.
